title: Nine Hundred Seats
subtitle: 容量与能力 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 容量与能力（科学与技术·工程与度量）
meta: 主题语境：容量与能力（科学与技术·工程与度量）　|　核心词汇：capacity　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 capacity 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my mother was sent to measure ① a capacity she could not fill, and she said the filling was the whole of the lesson. The ② capacity, meaning the volume and not the room, was nine hundred seats and was counted by whoever came last; a capacity, she said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ capacity in that hall had the same number, and the ④ capacity at the front, meaning the one the steward counted and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever measured properly. A capacity, my grandmother said, is nine parts arithmetic and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the arithmetic is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ capacity was the whole of the talent, meaning the ability it named and not the volume. The ⑥ capacity, meaning the ability and not any of that, is the only thing in a pupil that everybody praises and nobody questions; a capacity, he said, is either something you measure or the only word that means both a volume and an ability. She said the ability is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ capacity had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the arithmetic. The ⑧ capacity of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine hundred and eleven years of measuring; a capacity, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ capacity I remember is the one at the front, which was filled in 1977 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ capacity, my grandmother said in 1982, is the only thing that improves by being filled; every capacity, she said, is an ability that has agreed to look like a volume. She said the ability was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 容量；容纳能力
B. n. 容量（指那个容积本身，与厅堂相对）
C. 固定搭配：measure a capacity 测量容量
D. n. 容量（指那座厅里每一项）
E. n. 容量（指前面那一项）
F. n. 能力；才能（抽象：与容积相对）
G. n. 那份才能（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a capacity she could not fill
The capacity, meaning the volume and not the room
capacity was the whole of the talent
the capacity had become a number in a report
The capacity of the whole thing
A capacity, my grandmother said in 1982

answers.why: measure a capacity 意为“测量容量”，1957 年母亲被派去测量一个她填不满的容量。
capacity 意为“容量”，指那个容积本身而不是厅堂，九百个座位，由最后走的人清点。
capacity 指那座厅里每一项容量，每一项都是同样的数字。
capacity 指前面那一项（管理员数的那一项），是唯一有人认真测量过的。
capacity 意为“能力、才能”，与容积相对，父亲说 capacity 就是那份才能的全部。
capacity 为抽象用法，指那份才能本身，是学生身上人人都夸、却没人质疑的东西。
capacity 意为“容量、容纳能力”，到 1972 年这个 capacity 成了报告里的一个数字。
capacity 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九百个座位和十一年的测量。
capacity 意为“容量”，我记得的是前面那一项，1977 年坐满，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
capacity 为抽象总称，祖母说容量是唯一会因为被填满而变好的东西。
